article.title: 香港亞洲美容展以AI配對合資格買家與展商
article.summary: 亞洲美容展主辦方披露，本屆用Match&Meet安排獲選合資格買家與展商一對一洽談。
highlights: 亞洲國際博覽館聚焦成分、包裝及代工供應鏈。
香港會議展覽中心展示香水、美妝等品牌成品。
article.why: 美妝品牌參展前可把採購需求和目標客戶寫成可配對的資料。
article.next_step: 把產品類別、最低訂購量及目標市場填入展商資料，並記錄會後商機。
article.detail: 主辦方在展會公告中披露，買家計劃為獲選合資格買家安排個別行程，AI配對平台可協助他們與展商安排一對一洽談。供應鏈及品牌成品分設兩場，品牌可按目的準備不同資料。檢視效果時，可把成功配對、實際會面和展後商機分開記錄。這樣可辨識需要改善的是名單、邀約還是跟進。
article.title_en: Hong Kong's Cosmoprof Asia uses AI matching for selected buyers and exhibitors
article.summary_en: Cosmoprof Asia organisers described Match&Meet, which helps schedule one-to-one meetings between selected qualified buyers and exhibitors.
highlights_en: AsiaWorld-Expo focused on ingredients, packaging and manufacturing suppliers.
The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre showcased branded goods including fragrance and beauty products.
article.why_en: Beauty brands can describe sourcing needs and target customers in a form a matching system can use.
article.next_step_en: Add categories, minimum order quantities and target markets to exhibitor profiles and track follow-up leads.
article.detail_en: The organisers said the buyer programme created tailored itineraries for selected qualified buyers. An AI matching platform helps arrange one-to-one meetings with exhibitors. Suppliers and finished brands exhibited at separate venues. Track matches, actual meetings and post-event leads separately when evaluating the process. This helps identify whether to improve the shortlist, invitations or follow-up.
